message.content: {"caption":"Schematic of bounded, validation-gated skill optimization, contrasting controlled edits with unstable updates.","description":"A conceptual optimization landscape plots validation error vertically against skill space. A sequence of skill-document icons follows a blue path downhill through bounded edits, with check marks indicating accepted updates and red dashed arrows showing rejected side updates at a held-out selection gate. Gray dashed paths illustrate ad hoc updates with large semantic jumps and unstable behavior, ending at a suboptimal skill. A side panel maps optimization concepts such as gradient direction, learning rate, and validation check to skill-document edits, edit budgets, and held-out selection. A small model-and-skill illustration and labels highlight better task-specific ability, cross-model or harness generalization, and low-cost transfer and iteration.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
